First of all, this game is new. Brand new, just released. Not years old for once.

Second, this is basically just hangman with pop songs as the solutions to the puzzles. That is, granted, not terribly exciting, but there aren't a ton of trivia based video games and I think hangman works well in this context. There are other styles of trivia games in which you develop clues through questions, but many would be next to impossible to implement as a video game and few allow you to derive the answer purely through clever guessing, without any prior knowledge of the answer.
